initScript: setInterval(function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; if(e&&e.revealMesh){ e.revealMesh.visible=false; if(e.revealMesh.material) e.revealMesh.material.depthWrite=false; } } catch(err){} }, 50);

steps.label: prep
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; if(e&&e.revealMesh) e.revealMesh.visible=false; if(window.__labAurora) window.__labAurora.visible=false; var wu=window.__labWuMesh; var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; var info=null; if(wu){ var p=wu.position.clone(); p.project(cam); info={vis:wu.visible, screen:[Math.round((p.x*0.5+0.5)*1280),Math.round((-p.y*0.5+0.5)*720)], pos:[+wu.position.x.toFixed(2),+wu.position.y.toFixed(2),+wu.position.z.toFixed(2)]}; } return JSON.stringify({wu:info, ground:!!window.__labWuGround, hidden:(window.__labMoved||[]).filter(function(x){return String(x).indexOf('hide')>=0;}).length}); } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()

steps.label: render
steps.js: (function(){ try { var e=window.__experience; if(e&&e.revealMesh) e.revealMesh.visible=false; if(window.__labAurora) window.__labAurora.visible=false; var r=e.engine.renderer.instance; var sc=e.scene||(e.engine&&e.engine.scene); var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; r.render(sc,cam); return 'ok'; } catch(err){ return String(err); } })()

steps.js: (function(){ var wu=window.__labWuMesh; if(!wu) return null; var e=window.__experience; var cam=e.engine.camera.instance; var p=wu.position.clone(); p.project(cam); return [(p.x*0.5+0.5)*window.innerWidth,(-p.y*0.5+0.5)*window.innerHeight]; })()
